name: issue_620_fan_off_grace_blocks_idle_reactivation
description: A user turning the WHF off manually must not have it re-activated by the idle-open reactivation widening (Issue #244/#402/#504) while the fan-off grace is still active (Issue #620, Fix B)
notes: Occupant impact: on 2026-08-11 the user manually turned off the whole-house fan at 06:10:59.
Automation re-activated it 5 seconds later (06:11:04) via check_natural_vent_conditions()'s
_idle_open widening, directly undoing the user's action and contradicting
docs/grace-periods-spec.md's documented guarantee that a fan-off grace gates nat-vent
re-activation unconditionally. Root cause: _idle_open (automation.py) never checked
_grace_active at all, unlike the comfort-ceiling exception (Issue #134) sitting right
beside it. Fix B adds 'and not self._grace_active' to _idle_open's definition.
(a) Scenario effectiveness: reverting Fix B's one-line change (removing 'and not
self._grace_active' from _idle_open) would make this scenario fail -- the 06:16
temp_update would re-fire 'natural_ventilation' during the still-active grace window,
which the final assertion explicitly forbids.
(b) Docs-production alignment: docs/grace-periods-spec.md's Fan-Off Grace section is
updated (Issue #620 doc pass) to state this path is now correctly gated, matching
the Issue #134 comfort-ceiling exception's own documented precedent.
(c) User outcome: the fan a user just turned off stays off for the documented grace
duration, instead of the automation immediately overriding their action.

events.note: Early morning: indoor 70F, outdoor 63F -- favorable for free cooling.
Hot day forecast, cool mode wanted -- but nat-vent is currently favorable.
Window opens. outdoor 63F < indoor 66F, indoor > comfort_heat 64F -- nat-vent activates, WHF turns on.
User manually turns the WHF off at the remote -- no CA context, on_fan_turned_off() fires, fan-off grace (manual, 10800s) starts.
Same favorable conditions as before, window still open, 5 seconds into the fan-off grace -- this is the exact timing that reactivated the fan in the real incident. Must NOT reactivate now.
Five minutes into the grace, still favorable, window still open -- still must not reactivate.

assertions.reason: Window opens with favorable conditions -- nat-vent activates normally.
The externally-driven fan-off must be classified as manual (on_fan_turned_off -> fan_cancel, trigger=fan_off), starting the fan-off grace.

Issue #620 Fix B: _idle_open must not bypass an active fan-off grace. A decision-string assertion can't distinguish 'correctly stayed active' from 'incorrectly reactivated' since both produce the same natural_ventilation string -- this reads the final _fan_active flag directly, which must be False: the fan the user turned off at 06:10:59 must still be off 5+ minutes into the grace, even though conditions remain favorable for free cooling.

verdict.summary: Fan-off grace correctly blocks the idle-open nat-vent reactivation widening (Issue #620, Fix B)
verdict.observed_behavior: sensor_open -> natural_ventilation -> user turns fan off (fan_cancel, grace starts) -> repeated favorable temp_updates during grace produce no reactivation
verdict.expected_behavior: A fan the user just turned off stays off for the documented fan-off grace duration, even when conditions remain favorable for free cooling
